theme.name: Superhero
theme.style: Modern superhero comic-book collectible-card key art in a bold CG and comic hybrid style: dynamic inked linework with halftone-shaded painterly color, punchy and heroic, the way a premium superhero trading card paints its chase cards. Hot magenta-red key light rakes the subject from one side, a hard electric-yellow rim light separates it from a deep indigo night-city darkness, and dramatic speedline energy and haze fall away behind. One strong centered focal shape, isolated, uncluttered edges, nothing in the background competing with it, and it still reads at thumbnail size. Square composition with generous breathing room. Artwork only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable symbols, no UI labels, no card frame.
